SELECT * FROM (SELECT D.INVOICEDETAILID, M.INVOICEID, nvl(M.Invoicenumber, ' ') Invoicenumber, NVL(M.SUBMITNUMBER, ' ') SUBMITNUMBER, NVL(D.CHECKSTATUS, ' ') CHECKSTATUS, NVL(D.CHECKRESULT, '未检') CHECKRESULT, NVL(D.MATERIALTYPE, ' ') MATERIALTYPE, NVL(D.DELIVERNUMBER, ' ') DELIVERNUMBER, NVL(D.PO, ' ') PO, NVL(P.Pnid, ' ') PNID, NVL(D.PN, ' ') PN, NVL(D.VENDORCODE, ' ') VENDORCODE, NVL(D.VENDORNAME, ' ') VENDORNAME, NVL(D.TOTALQTY, 0) TOTALQTY, D.TOTALQTY - NVL(D.REMAININGQTY, 0) REMAININGQTY, NVL(D.VENDORLOTNO, ' ') VENDORLOTNO, NVL(P.PARTSPEC, ' ') PARTSPEC, NVL(P.LARGECATEGORY, ' ') LARGECATEGORY, NVL(P.Unitqty, 1) UNITQTY, NVL(p.ESDLEVEL, ' ') ESDLEVEL, NVL(p.MSDLEVEL, ' ') MSDLEVEL, NVL(p.LEADFREE, ' ') LEADFREE, NVL(d.rmapo, ' ') RMAPO, NVL(P.CONTROL_FLAG, 'N') CONTROL_FLAG, NVL(GETMARK(D.PN), ' ') MARK, NVL(V.LAST_NAME, ' ') CAIGOUYUANNAME, 'Y' APPROVED_FLAG,
nvl(d.DATETIME, sysdate) DATETIME, nvl(d.LIMITEDDAY, sysdate) LIMITEDDAY, nvl(d.PACKSTYLE, ' ') PACKSTYLE, nvl(d.VENDORWEEKCODE, ' ') VENDORWEEKCODE, nvl(d.VENDORSN, '/') VENDORSN, nvl(d.MATERIALSTORAGE, ' ') MATERIALSTORAGE, P.UNIT FROM RMM_INVOICE M, RMM_INVOICEDETAIL D, PARTNUMBER P, cux_e2m_po_buyer_v@Jcd_Demo V WHERE 1 = 1 AND M.INVOICEID = D.Invoiceid(+) AND D.PN = P.PN(+) AND D.PO = V.PO_NUMBER(+) AND M.STATE IN ('OH', 'DEFAULT') AND D.CHECKSTATUS IN ('OPEN', 'PRINTING') AND P.CONTROL_FLAG = 'Y' AND D.Invoicenumber LIKE 'TSIQC%' AND D.INVOICEDETAILID = #{id}) WHERE ROWNUM=1
